_comment: Hyperparameter grid for tools/ml/train.py. Selection uses leave-one-session-out CV on the training sessions only; ties prefer the shallower tree. Keep the tree bounded (depth <= 5) so worst-case inference time stays constant and tiny.
_label_consistency: Exclude NORMAL/ROUGH windows with no handling motion (thresholds = max gyro_max / acc_std of TRAINING STATIONARY windows). Excluded windows are listed in report.md; metrics on the uncleaned test set are reported too. Added 2026-11-18 after S01-S04 showed operators resting mid-trial.
